In Table&nbsp;\@ref(tab:SubwayHyp),
match the RQs with the appropriate *null hypothesis* (where the symbols are defined as expected).

Then,
match the RQs with the appropriate *alternative hypothesis* (where the symbols are defined as expected).





```{r SubwayHyp, echo=FALSE}
Terms <- array( "", dim=c(11, 2))

colnames(Terms) <- c("Research question", "Hypothesis")

Terms[, 1] <- 
  c("1. At Subway, is the mean length of a 12-inch sub really 12 inches?",
    "2. At Subway, is the mean length of a 12-inch sub \\emph{different}",
    "~ ~  for white and wholemeal subs?",
    "3. At Subway, is the proportion of 12-inch subs that are \\emph{shorter}",
    "~ ~ than 12 inches different for white and wholemeal subs?",
    "4. At Subway, is the mean length of a 12-inch sub \\emph{longer}",
    "~ ~ for white and  wholemeal subs?",
    rep("", 4))

Terms[, 2] <- 
  c("A. $p_\\textrm{white} = p_\\textrm{wholemeal}$",
    "B. $\\mu_\\textrm{white} = \\mu_\\textrm{wholemeal}$",
    "C. $\\mu_\\textrm{white} = \\mu_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 12$",
    "D. $\\bar{x}_\\textrm{white} = \\bar{x}_\\textrm{wholemeal}$",
    "E. $\\bar{x}_\\textrm{white} = \\bar{x}_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 12$",
    "F. $\\mu = 12$",
    "G. $\\mu_\\textrm{white} \\ne \\mu_\\textrm{wholmeal}$",
    "H. $p_\\textrm{white} = p_\\textrm{wholemeal} < 12$",
    "I. $\\mu \\ne 12$",
    "J. $\\bar{x} \\ne 12$",
    "K. $p_\\textrm{white} = p_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 12$")



if( knitr::is_latex_output() ) {
  kable(Terms,
      format="latex",
      booktab=TRUE,
      align=c("l", "l"),
      escape = FALSE, # Makes the  $\\mu$ (e.g.) work in latex
      linesep="\\addlinespace",
      caption="Match RQs with the null (and then the alternative) hypotheses") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width=FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold=TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width="0.68\\\\textwidth") %>%
  column_spec(2, width="0.3\\\\textwidth")
}
```
